rationale: Deployment is the phase AIDecisionMaker's own source calls out as the one that 'largely decides rounds 1-2', it owns twelve tunable terrain coefficients (DEPLOY_TERRAIN_*), and until 2026-08-08 it had zero benchmark coverage — every fixture in the repo started at round 1 Command with the armies already placed, so _decide_deployment was never called and none of those twelve parameters could move a measured result. This exam runs the real deployment phase on a fixture that starts there with nothing on the table, and checks two things: that units actually get deployed, and that _record_choice("deployment", ...) emits scored candidates for them. The second half is what makes the twelve coefficients tunable at all — a decision with no record is invisible to every offline analysis in tools/ai_lab.
setup: # Nothing to construct. The fixture's whole point is that it starts empty:
# every unit UNDEPLOYED, every model position null. Count what we start
# with so the assertion below is measuring a change, not a constant.

assert.name: player 1 actually placed units on the table
every deployment decision is recorded with scored candidates
deployment records name the DEPLOY_TERRAIN_* parameters they read
